newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Yangming Marine keen to widen China links.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Yangming Marine keen to widen China links.

text.p: Taiwan's Yangming Marine Corp, among several firms recently allowed to sail directly to China, is seeking permits to expand service to the mainland's major ports, transport officials said on Wednesday.

"Yangming Marine applied to Kaohsiung port to start a direct offshore shipping link between Kaohsiung and the mainland ports of Dalian, Shanghai, Qingdao and Tianjin," a Taiwan transport ministry official told Reuters.
Yangming Marine officials were unavailable for comment. Kaohsiung, in southern Taiwan, is the island's main container port and one of the world's busiest.

Taiwan shipping industry sources said Yangming was tipped that Beijing -- Taipei's arch rival since a 1949 civil war split -- would soon open additional ports for direct links and was eager to capture the opportunity.

Taiwan, which had banned direct links across the Taiwan strait sinc 1949, has allowed limited direct crossings since May between Kaohsiung and China's Xiamen and Fuzhou under what it calls an "offshore transshipment centre" scheme.

Under the scheme, arriving mainland cargoes cannot enter Taiwan customs but can be transshipped at Kaohsiung for onward passage to third countries. Likewise, Taiwan cargoes cannot be put aboard ships sailing directly to the Chinese mainland.
